Before [[137 ABY]], the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Darth Havok|Eshkar Niin]] abandoned his vows to the [[Fel Empire|Empire]] and '''attacked''' the Empress [[Elliah Fel]] on a rooftop in a [[City/Legends|city]] filled with [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscrapers]]. [[Antares Draco]], Niin's former Imperial Knight apprentice, had been sent by the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the deserter and was present on the rooftop as well. Draco and Fel both called on Niin to remember his vows, but he [[Telekinesis/Legends|shoved]] Draco away with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and struck Fel down. Draco retaliated and mortally wounded Niin; he believed his former master to be dead and returned to the Imperial Knights. Niin survived and joined the [[One Sith]], becoming the [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Havok.
